draw.name: Backpack
draw.desc: Carry 2 extra items (5 total). Does not count toward your carry limit

draw.name: Crucifix
draw.desc: +3 to run from the Vampire or Killer Doll

draw.name: Holy Water
draw.desc: Deal 5 extra damage to the Vampire, Werewolf, or Killer Doll

draw.name: See a Ghost
draw.desc: Drop all items. Costs 1 action to pick up each item. They stay on the floor until every player leaves the room

draw.name: Silver Stake
draw.desc: Deal 8 extra damage to the Werewolf

draw.name: Small Bag
draw.desc: Carry 1 extra item (4 total). Does not count toward your carry limit

draw.name: Step on a Creaky Floor
draw.desc: Add 1 to the Killer roll in this room

draw.name: Step on a Squeaky Teddy Bear
draw.desc: Add 1 to the Killer roll in this room

draw.name: Trip!
draw.desc: Drop all items. Costs 1 action to pick up each item. They stay on the floor until every player leaves the room

draw.name: Wind-Up Clock
draw.desc: Play to distract the killer in two turns; the killer won't appear that turn

ghost.name: Chill in the Air
ghost.desc: Choose a room. The next player to enter must make the Killer roll immediately on entry.

ghost.name: Cold Spot
ghost.desc: Choose a room. Subtract 2 from the next Killer roll made there — the killer is less likely to appear

ghost.name: Familiar Halls
ghost.desc: A chosen player may return to the room they just left, or stay put, without facing the killer on their next turn

ghost.name: Floating Objects
ghost.desc: Switch the Key cards between two rooms

ghost.name: Glowing Room
ghost.desc: Choose a room. Add 2 to the next Killer roll made there — the killer is more likely to appear

ghost.name: Grave Chill
ghost.desc: Choose a player to get -2 on their next Run or Fight

ghost.name: Locked Door
ghost.desc: Seal a doorway for one round

ghost.name: Poltergeist
ghost.desc: Switch the Key cards between two rooms

ghost.name: Possess
ghost.desc: Take control of a living player's entire turn.

ghost.name: Restless Spirit
ghost.desc: The killer does not heal for 2 turns

ghost.name: Second Sight
ghost.desc: Choose a player to get +2 on their next Search

ghost.name: Slam the Door
ghost.desc: Choose a player to immediately leave their room into the hallway

ghost.name: Spook!
ghost.desc: Choose a room. All players in the chosen room drop their items.

key.name: Not a Key
key.desc: No key here. You find something else instead: draw 1 card from the Draw deck

allegiance.name: Guardian — Echoes
allegiance.desc: You win if the group meets its VP threshold. Objective: A key is found in the same room twice (+1 VP)

allegiance.name: Guardian — Scattered Bones
allegiance.desc: You win if the group meets its VP threshold. Objective: All 3 keys are found in a different rooms (+1 VP)

allegiance.name: Guardian — Where I Fell
allegiance.desc: You win if the group meets its VP threshold. Objective: A key must be found in the room where you died (+1 VP)

allegiance.name: Malevolent
allegiance.desc: You win if the group fails to meet its VP threshold.

character.name: Athlete
character.desc: Bravery - High (+2 Fight) | Wits - Low (no bonus) | Health - High (7)

character.name: Caretaker
character.desc: Bravery - Low (no bonus) | Wits - High (+2 Search/Run) | Health - High (7)

character.name: Detective
character.desc: Bravery - High (+2 Fight) | Wits - High (+2 Search/Run) | Health - Low (5)

character.name: Movie Star
character.desc: Bravery - Medium (+1 Fight) | Wits - Medium (+1 Search/Run) | Health - High (7)

character.name: Priest
character.desc: Bravery High - (+2 Fight) | Wits - Medium (+1 Search/Run) | Health - Medium (6)

killer.name: Killer Doll
killer.desc: Very Scary | Difficulty - Medium (Appears on 6-10) | Health - 8
